trigger.reading: Each query's attachment pass runs ear over readFileState, the files the agent has read whole (a read with offset or limit is skipped). A file whose mtime is later than the recorded read and whose content differs yields {type: edited_text_file, filename, snippet} (the diff; empty past 16384 snippet chars in a pass). Who wrote the file is not read: any writer outside the agent's own Edit/Write updates of readFileState counts (inferred from the code: those tools update readFileState). The only inner gate is a remote feature flag, tengu_fallow_plover, which adds a skip and is not a study-settable switch.

switch.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ATTACHMENTS
switch.reading: The only switch: with CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ATTACHMENTS (or CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE, or a bare fork) the whole per-query attachment list is skipped; only a small set is still produced (the mention pass, agent_listing_delta and two others). It also gates total_tokens reminders, deferred tools, proactivity and the AGENTS.md plug-in. So it would drop kinds round 3's 54 graded transcripts carry (environment, instructions, task_reminder, total_tokens_reminder and more): no round-3 parity. No targeted switch for changed_files exists in this binary. The changelog says repository settings cannot set it; the shell, user and managed settings can.
